description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerManager class, which provides static methods for managing and retrieving loggers within the log4php logging framework. It includes methods for checking logger existence, obtaining current loggers, getting the root logger, retrieving specific loggers, and controlling configuration and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: LoggerManager
classes.description: A static class providing management functions for log4php loggers, including retrieval, existence checks, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a logger with the specified name exists in the repository.

methods.name: getCurrentLoggers
methods.description: Returns an array of all current logger instances.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a logger by name, optionally using a factory.

methods.name: getLoggerRepository
methods.description: Returns the LoggerHierarchy singleton representing the logger repository.

methods.name: resetConfiguration
methods.description: Resets the logger configuration, destroying loggers.

methods.name: setRepositorySelector
methods.description: A placeholder method that does nothing.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Safely shuts down all loggers and appenders.
